hypothesis: Temporary relative mispricing between same-expiry SBER ordinary/preferred futures partially converges over five sessions. The issuer/share-class relationship is chosen before prices; no correlation-mined pair, different-maturity calendar spread, RI/MIX currency identity or thirty-stock residual basket.

method_evidence.fact: The 2015 policy states an aim of equal ordinary/preferred dividends. This is pre-period economic motivation, NOT proof of equal prices, conversion rights, equal subsequent payments or a binding 2023-2025 policy. No dividend amount enters the signal or return.

source.selected_identity: all12 SBER plus all12 SBERP contracts, 100 underlying shares each, paired only by exact expiration; no outcomes or volume ranking
source.calendar: factual core-four effective dates from pinned V64 recent active-map, only2023-2025; read date column only
source.rights: Previously admitted public MOEX source for personal research; raw data remain outside Git

signal.schedule: First factual session of each W-SUN week, decision15:50Moscow from completed15:40 candle. Select nearest listed same-expiry pair with minimum DTE; never fall back to a more liquid pair after missing data.
signal.formula: log(common_close/preferred_close); center=median of20 strictly-prior paired valid daily observations of SAME two contracts, scale=1.4826*MAD. Valid means positive finite prices/positive volume and actual available_at<=that day's15:50. Current |z|>=2 selects common direction=-sign(z), preferred opposite.
signal.missing: No imputation; fewer20 prior paired observations in63calendar days, zero scale, missing current completed pair or no eligible maturity means no event. Historical level observations may have gaps; no return is computed across those gaps.
signal.control: At the exact same selected dates/contracts: always short common and long preferred, separating timing/direction from static share-class preference. Control not promotable post outcome.
signal.fit: none, no neural model, no parameter search

execution.entry: next factual calendar session15:50open, strictly later than decision day
execution.exit: fifth following factual session after entry, same exact contracts; require all six intervening daily15:50 bars for both legs to have finite positive opens and positive volume
execution.unit: one common plus one preferred futures contract, opposite signs; quote-change PnL normalized by sum of entry quote notionals, not by margin or account NAV
execution.cost_formula: bps/10000*(common_entry+preferred_entry+common_exit+preferred_exit)/(common_entry+preferred_entry), covering both entry and exit of both legs
execution.capacity: report observed one-contract participation in all six daily bars and count complete events satisfying1% everywhere; NOT proof of displayed BBO or fill
execution.overlap: event opportunities may overlap around holidays; never compound or sum them into a portfolio return
execution.missing: selected event with missing/inactive daily bar or truncated future calendar is unresolved and stays in denominator; never change selected events after outcomes

screen_gates.requirements: no unresolved selected events; primary mean and median net>0 at both costs; mean net>0 in each of all3years; primary mean net strictly above control at both costs
screen_gates.pass_means: STAGE2_PORTFOLIO_CANDIDATE only: full cash/margin/integer/risk ledger still required, then robustness/executable BBO/prospective demo; no goal reduction to positive event mean

reporting: all weekly decisions/reasons, selected/complete/unresolved counts, both arms/costs/all3year event means, endpoint/participation evidence; portfolio CAGR/Sharpe/MDD explicitly null
limitations: A same-issuer share-class relationship is not fungibility or guaranteed convergence. Voting rights, investor segmentation, funding, dividends and liquidity premia can change permanently.
This is a five-session endpoint/event screen, not a cash/margin portfolio. Normalized quote-change opportunity is not a realized account return; overlapping opportunities are not additive.

Current descriptions do not prove all historical contract-point values, broker fees or margin. Anonymous candles do not prove original executable simultaneous BID/OFFER, quote depth or short-fill capacity.
Already-open2023-2025 development and a narrow pair cannot demonstrate predictable20-50% annual income. No historical2026 outcomes or live orders are authorized.
forbidden_followups: change sign, pair, lookback, maturity, weekly clock, threshold, holding period or costs after outcomes
